content: <thought>The tool `return_possible_fragments` already gave a list of fragment SMILES. The task asks for “SMILES for all possible linked fragments of the sample's molecule.” This likely means we should output the list of fragments returned, but we should ensure they are valid neutral SMILES (no charges) and remove duplicates. Many fragments contain charged atoms (e.g., [NH-], [CH-], [c-]) which are unlikely to be part of the neutral molecule C16H28O3. Valid fragments should be neutral and chemically reasonable. I will validate each SMILES and keep only those that are valid (RDKit can parse them) and are neutral (no brackets with charges). After filtering, I will present the remaining SMILES in a list format as required.
